requires: Gen2 MPC (aarch64), MPC OS 3.10.1 or newer; development prototype, hardware test pending
about: Local development prototype of the Geonkick DSP for MPC. Sixteen independent pad sounds, three layers and nine oscillators per sound. Single and MIDI kit modes. MPC-app acceptance and final-release CPU benchmark pending. Adapted source is available in the local project; public fork/release is pending.
